                   JP2
(TxD) (GND) (RxD) [3.3]
Serial runs at 57600 bps. U-Boot offers a small multiple choice menu - be quick. Once booted, the device offers a terminal interface asking for `User Name:` and `Password:`. You can get out of this by visiting ''/wlanMP.asp'' (not linked from the interface anywhere) and submitting a shell escape to ''killall setup'' (which is the process asking you to log in). See image below for an example. ===See also=== *[[Edimax EW-7415APn]] *[[Edimax EW-7415PDn]] • [https://www.edimax.com/edimax/merchandise/merchandise_detail/data/edimax/global/home_legacy_access_points/ew-7415pdn/ PPage] ==Images== [[File:Sitecom-WL-330-v1-002-PCB-top.jpg|thumb|left|JP2 (near the bottom of the photo): starting from the square, pads appear to be 3V3, RX, GND, TX]] [[File:Sitecom-Wl-330-interface-get-shell.png|thumb|left|shell escape]] __NOTOC__
